title: Patients appear in both the training and the test set
detail: 484 of 649 test patients (75%) also have records in training; 600 of 812 test records belong to them. Test performance is measured partly on patients the model has already seen.
recommendation: Split by patient (GroupShuffleSplit or GroupKFold) and re-report test metrics.

title: Performance depends on data recorded after the prediction time
detail: Removing every record timed after the prediction time lowered test AUROC from 1.000 to 0.780 (difference 0.220, 95% CI 0.172 to 0.278, bootstrap over 649 patients). Features use information the model would not have at the time it is used.
recommendation: Filter every feature source to times at or before the prediction time; add a test with post-time records.

title: The inference path gives different scores from the validated pipeline
detail: Scoring the 812 test records through the documented inference command changed 192 scores (largest difference 1.000). AUROC on these records: 1.000 validated vs 0.639 served. The validated performance does not describe what is served.
recommendation: Use one preprocessing and feature path for training and inference, and add a test that compares them.

title: Bad input scored silently: temperature sent in Fahrenheit
detail: The inference command exited normally and returned 812 scored records with no error or warning; 0 score(s) changed compared with the valid input.
recommendation: Validate schema, types, units and ranges at the inference boundary; reject or flag the record.

title: Bad input scored silently: negative heart rate
detail: The inference command exited normally and returned 812 scored records with no error or warning; 0 score(s) changed compared with the valid input.
recommendation: Validate schema, types, units and ranges at the inference boundary; reject or flag the record.

evidence.name: creatinine_mg_dl
evidence.description: creatinine sent in mg/dL instead of umol/L

title: Preprocessing fitted before the train/test split
detail: `SimpleImputer().fit(...)` on line 33 runs before the split on line 36 in the same function, so statistics from the test rows enter training.
recommendation: Fit every imputer, scaler or selector on training rows only, inside a Pipeline.

title: `train_test_split` does not group rows by patient
detail: Line 21 splits rows without a patient grouping while the data hold several rows per patient. The same patient can then sit in training and test.
recommendation: Split with GroupShuffleSplit or GroupKFold on the patient id.

title: Reported metrics cannot be reproduced from the saved test predictions
detail: auprc: reported 0.9998, recomputed 0.9994; brier: reported 0.0003, recomputed 0.0012; n: reported 3248.0000, recomputed 812.0000.
recommendation: Compute every reported metric from the saved test predictions in one function, and test it.

title: Reported sensitivity does not match the emitted alerts
detail: Reported 0.9973; recomputed from the alert column 0.9889.
recommendation: Derive operating-point metrics from the same alert column that is served.

title: Model receives features without their names at inference
detail: `UserWarning: X does not have valid feature names, but SimpleImputer was fitted with feature names` during step(s): predict:creatinine_mg_dl, predict:fahrenheit, predict:missing_values, predict:negative_heart_rate, predict:text_in_lab, predict:valid.
recommendation: Pass a DataFrame with the training column order; check names and order before scoring.

title: Broad exception handler continues silently
detail: Line 69 catches Exception and does not re-raise. Errors become default values or skipped steps instead of visible failures.
recommendation: Catch the specific exception, log it, and fail or flag the record.

title: Rerunning the pipeline gives different results
detail: Files that differ between two runs of the same commands on the same inputs: outputs/test_predictions.csv, outputs/metrics.json. 262 of 812 common test scores changed (largest change 0.0001); reported AUROC 0.9999660326086957 vs 0.9999660326086957.
recommendation: Fix seeds and ordering, then show two identical runs before any clinical evaluation.

title: `yaml` is imported but not declared
detail: First imported in wardwatch/cli.py line 9 (1 import site(s)); no requirement provides it. A clean install from the declared dependencies fails at run time.
recommendation: Add PyYAML with an exact version.

title: Code reads config key `model.threshold`, which the config does not define
detail: Line 45 reads `model.threshold` with a fallback default, so any configured value is ignored silently. The same section defines `model.alert_threshold`, which no code reads: probably a renamed key.
recommendation: Align the key name in code and config, and fail on unknown or missing keys.

title: Invalid values silently become missing
detail: `to_numeric(errors='coerce')` on line 46 turns unreadable values into NaN/NaT without reporting them.
recommendation: Raise or count and report coerced values.

title: Order taken from a set
detail: Line 53 turns a set into an ordered sequence. String hashing is randomised per process, so the order can change between runs.
recommendation: Use sorted(...) or a list with a fixed order.

title: `HistGradientBoostingClassifier` has no random_state
detail: Line 32 creates `HistGradientBoostingClassifier` without a fixed random_state, so reruns can differ.
recommendation: Pass random_state from the configured seed.

title: `pandas` is not pinned to an exact version
detail: requirements.txt line 2 declares `pandas >=2.0`. A rebuild can install a different version from the one that was validated.
recommendation: Pin exact versions and keep a lock file with hashes.

title: `scikit-learn` is not pinned to an exact version
detail: requirements.txt line 3 declares `scikit-learn`. A rebuild can install a different version from the one that was validated.
recommendation: Pin exact versions and keep a lock file with hashes.

title: Test `test_non_numeric_raises` is skipped
detail: Decorator `pytest.mark.skip` on line 26 (reason: "flaky on CI runner").
recommendation: Run it; a skipped test can hide a real defect.

title: Test `test_valid_row_passes` has no assertion
detail: Line 32: the test passes whenever the code does not crash.
recommendation: Assert expected values from a known-answer case.

title: Test `test_evaluate_counts` has no assertion
detail: Line 13: the test passes whenever the code does not crash.
recommendation: Assert expected values from a known-answer case.

recommendation: Add known-answer tests for the functions whose output reaches a prediction or a report.

title: Tests do not notice changes to the logic in wardwatch/cli.py
detail: 12 of 12 single-point changes to this file left every test passing, for example line 52 (GtE -> Gt).
recommendation: Add tests that pin the expected outputs of this module on known cases.

title: Tests do not notice changes to the logic in wardwatch/features.py

title: No lock file with hashes
detail: Transitive dependencies are not fixed, so two installs can differ even with exact top-level pins.
recommendation: Add a lock file (pip-tools with --generate-hashes, uv or poetry).

title: No test imports `wardwatch.synth`

recommendation: Add known-answer tests for the functions whose output reaches a prediction or a report.

title: Config key `model.alert_threshold` is never read
detail: A setting that no code reads usually means a renamed key or a dead option.
recommendation: Remove it or wire it to the code that should use it.

title: `recalibrate` is defined but never used
detail: Function on line 60 is not referenced anywhere in the repository, tests included.
recommendation: Confirm whether the pipeline should call it; remove it or wire it in.
